lines.text: Professor Hoot and I are building a rocket! And we have to finish before sunset! <break time="0.5s" /> I'll just watch ONE quick video about rocket fins… <break time="1.6s" /> Up next? <break time="0.9s" /> Oh, and this one! <break time="1.2s" /> Wait… <break time="0.5s" /> where did the sun go? <break time="0.4s" /> Our rocket isn't finished!

Hi, I'm Dexter. <break time="0.4s" /> And I have a mystery: why couldn't I stop after ONE video? <break time="0.6s" /> What do you think? <break time="0.4s" /> Was it because I'm just bad at stopping… <break time="0.5s" /> or did something keep pressing play? <break time="0.5s" /> Have a think!
I know! <break time="0.3s" /> I just need SUPER willpower! <break time="0.4s" /> Watch this. One video… and I stop. <break time="2.2s" /> Okay. <break time="0.5s" /> That didn't work.

“What did you notice, Dexter… right at the end of the video?” <break time="0.7s" /> Let's watch the end again, very closely. <break time="0.8s" /> Look! A little countdown: “Up next… three, two, one.” <break time="0.4s" /> Nobody pressed play. <break time="0.3s" /> The app pressed it for me! <break time="0.7s" /> That's called autoplay: when one video ends, the next one starts all by itself. <break time="0.4s" /> Lots of apps are built that way, so it's hard for anyone to stop, even grown-ups. <break time="0.4s" /> It's not because I'm bad. <break time="0.3s" /> It's how it's built.

Let's test it. <break time="0.3s" /> Professor Hoot, can you switch autoplay off? <break time="1.4s" /> Ooh. <break time="0.4s" /> Now when a video ends, nothing happens. <break time="0.4s" /> I get to choose. <break time="0.5s" /> And I choose… <break time="0.4s" /> rocket!

And you know when else this matters? <break time="0.4s" /> Bedtime. <break time="0.5s" /> Kids our age need 9 to 12 hours of sleep every night, <break time="0.3s" /> and scientists found that kids who use screens at bedtime often sleep less, and feel sleepier the next day. <break time="0.6s" /> So tonight I'm setting a timer, <break time="0.3s" /> and when it rings, my tablet goes to bed first. <break time="0.5s" /> Goodnight, tablet!

Three… two… one… <break time="0.3s" /> We did it! <break time="0.7s" /> So, what did we discover? <break time="0.4s" /> Videos can keep playing by themselves, but you can be the boss: <break time="0.3s" /> switch autoplay off with a grown-up, <break time="0.3s" /> use a timer, <break time="0.3s" /> and give your screen a bedtime. <break time="0.7s" /> Your mission: with a grown-up, find the autoplay switch on one app you use, and decide together if it should be on or off. <break time="0.7s" /> Want to read this story again? It's at dexty dot live. <break time="0.7s" /> Did you know that? <break time="0.4s" /> Now you do. <break time="0.3s" /> Bye for now!
